name: CVE-2026-77790 - RegistrationMagic WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-77790 - RegistrationMagic WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The RegistrationMagic plugin for WordPress before 6.0.9.4 is vulnerable to SQL injection via the 'rm_sortby' GET parameter on the admin page /wp-admin/admin.php?page=rm_form_manage. The parameter is used unsanitised in a SQL statement; a backtick breaks out of the identifier quoting, allowing a time-based blind injection. The request places a backtick-breakout sub-select SLEEP payload in rm_sortby. Authenticated (admin, or a lower role granted page access). No vendor WAF rule found; built from the WPScan advisory.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/42c48c95-1384-4414-9236-64f44bea9027/ (advisory / PoC - rm_sortby, rm_form_manage)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-77790 (CVE record)

description:

WooCommerce before 11.0 is vulnerable to authenticated (Shop Manager+) blind SQL injection via the date_type parameter of the Analytics Orders Stats REST endpoint (GET /wp-json/wc-analytics/reports/orders/stats). The value (also settable via the woocommerce_date_type option) is interpolated as a date column name into the report SQL without validation against a known-column allowlist. This request sends a time-based SLEEP subquery in date_type. No vendor WAF rule found; built from the fix PR diff.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://github.com/woocommerce/woocommerce/pull/67554 (fix PR, sanitize_date_column_name on date_type)
- https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/woocommerce/vulnerability/wordpress-woocommerce-plugin-10-9-4-sql-injection-vulnerability (advisory)

Unsanitized input is interpolated into a MySQL query; the real exploit chains INTO DUMPFILE for RCE. This request sends a proof-only time-based blind payload (AND SLEEP) in userRes; the path username segment is a required valid-account placeholder (shown as /user/). No vendor WAF rule found; built from the KIS-2026-12 / VulnCheck advisory.

An authenticated administrator reaches it via POST /admin/api/stopword/save with the stopWord JSON field. This request sends a UNION SELECT in the stopWord value. description:

The orderBy and sortOrder request parameters are concatenated into the ORDER BY clause of a SQL query without sufficient validation, allowing an authenticated user to inject arbitrary SQL and, on MySQL/MariaDB, disclose files via LOAD_FILE(). The limit field is destructured from the unvalidated JSON request body (bypassing the Zod schema) and interpolated directly into a Cloudflare Analytics Engine SQL query via a LIMIT ${limit} template literal. The request sends a UNION ALL SELECT payload against system.tables in the limit field. Built from the GitHub Security Advisory and VulnCheck PoC.

name: CVE-2026-55509 - WsgiDAV MySQLBrowserProvider SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-55509 - WsgiDAV MySQLBrowserProvider SQL Injection
description:

The request sends a boolean-based payload (0' OR '1'='1) in the URL path key. Built from the GitHub Security Advisory PoC. Note: file-content/path inspection by WAFs varies; this is a path-based SQLi signature.

name: CVE-2026-54350 - Budibase NoSQL Injection

description:

name: CVE-2026-41581 - Frappe Framework Blog List SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41581 - Frappe Framework Blog List SQL Injection
description:
Frappe Framework before 15.106.0 / 16.16.0 is vulnerable to SQL injection in get_blog_list (frappe/website/doctype/blog_post/blog_post.py), which builds the blog listing query with Python str.format() and inserts the pagination values limit_start and limit_page_length into the LIMIT/OFFSET clause WITHOUT escaping (txt/category/blogger are db.escape()'d, the limit values are not). get_blog_list is reached over HTTP through the guest-allowed web-list method frappe.www.list.get for doctype "Blog Post"; the request sends a UNION SELECT payload in the limit_start parameter. name: CVE-2026-41478 - Saltcorn Mobile Sync SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41478 - Saltcorn Mobile Sync SQL Injection
description:
Saltcorn before 1.4.6 / 1.5.6 / 1.6.0-beta.5 contains a SQL injection in the mobile-sync routes. In the POST /sync/load_changes handler, the value req.body.syncInfos[<tableName>].maxLoadedId is interpolated directly into the SQL WHERE clause in getSyncRows() without casting or binding (the fix casts it with Number() and binds it as $1). Any authenticated low-privilege user with read access to at least one table can inject arbitrary SQL. The request sends a UNION SELECT payload in syncInfos.users.maxLoadedId via a JSON body. name: CVE-2026-41457 - OwnTone Server DAAP Query SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41457 - OwnTone Server DAAP Query SQL Injection
description:
OwnTone Server 28.4 through 29.0 contain a SQL injection in DAAP query/filter handling. For integer-mapped DAAP fields, the value is appended verbatim to the SQL string in sql_append_dmap_clause (src/parsers/daap_parser.y) via sql_append(result, "%s", v->data) with no numeric validation; the fix parses the value with strtoll. The query=/filter= parameters are read by query_params_set() for endpoints such as /databases/N/items. The request sends a DAAP query on an integer field (dmap.itemid) with a UNION SELECT injected after the colon. No vendor WAF rule found; built from the fix commit and source analysis.

References used to recreate this request:

name: CVE-2026-41453 - Krayin CRM Lead DataGrid Blind SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41453 - Krayin CRM Lead DataGrid Blind SQL Injection
description:
Krayin CRM before 2.2.4 contains a blind SQL injection in the leads DataGrid (packages/Webkul/Admin/src/DataGrids/Lead/LeadDataGrid.php), where request()->input('rotten_lead.in') is concatenated directly into a havingRaw() call without binding or casting (the fix uses a ? placeholder with an (int) cast). name: CVE-2026-2412 - expresstech Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-2412 - expresstech Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) SQL Injection
description:

The REST create/save question handlers (quiz-survey-master/v1/questions/) store merged_question as 'linked_question' only sanitize_text_field()'d; it is later split on commas and concatenated into an IN(...) clause in qsm_rest_get_questions without intval()/prepare(). description:

name: CVE-2026-2024 - savitasoni PhotoStack Gallery WordPress Plugin SQL Injection

description:

description:

Frappe CRM 1.53.1 has multiple SQL injections in the Dashboard controller (crm/api/dashboard.py): the whitelisted get_chart method dispatches to resolver functions (get_total_leads/get_total_deals/...) that in 1.53.1 concatenated the user-controlled from_date/to_date/user parameters into dynamic SQL. The request calls the get_chart API method with a time-based SQLi payload in from_date. Endpoint and parameters confirmed from the frappe/crm source via gh code search; fix moved to the query builder (PR #1339). No vendor WAF rule found.

- https://github.com/frappe/crm/pull/1339 (fix PR)
- https://github.com/frappe/crm/blob/develop/crm/api/dashboard.py (controller source)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-11461 (CVE record)

name: CVE-2025-11454 - Specific Content For Mobile WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2025-11454 - Specific Content For Mobile WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The Specific Content For Mobile WordPress plugin (<= 0.5.5) is vulnerable to authenticated (Contributor+) SQL injection in the eos_scfm_duplicate_post_as_draft() function due to insufficient escaping and lack of prepared statements on a user-supplied parameter. name: CVE-2025-11452 - Asgaros Forum WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2025-11452 - Asgaros Forum WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The Asgaros Forum WordPress plugin (<= 3.1.0) is vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection via the asgarosforum_unread_exclude cookie. The cookie is JSON-decoded in includes/forum-unread.php and its keys/values are concatenated unsanitized into SQL (includes/forum-content.php: "...WHERE p.parent_id = {topic_id} AND p.id > {excluded_items[topic_id]}..."). The request loads the forum unread view with a UNION SELECT/SLEEP payload inside the cookie. Cookie vector and SQL sink confirmed from the plugin source via gh code search and the fix commit. The forum page is site-specific, so the /?view=unread path is a representative trigger (flagged); the injection is in the Cookie header, which the WAF inspects regardless of path. No vendor WAF rule found.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/asgaros-forum/asgaros-forum-310-unauthenticated-sql-injection (Wordfence advisory)
- https://github.com/Asgaros/asgaros-forum/commit/41e499f26cb534c55587c35496e6f9056753b942 (fix commit)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-11452 (CVE record)

name: CVE-2025-10587 - jackdewey Community Events WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2025-10587 - jackdewey Community Events WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The Community Events plugin for WordPress (<= 1.5.1) is vulnerable to authenticated (Subscriber+) SQL injection via the event_category parameter. Source review (community-events.php) confirms event_category is read from $_POST and concatenated directly into the events JOIN/WHERE query (ce_events/ce_venues/ce_category) without preparation. This request sends a UNION SELECT payload in the event_category POST parameter. The parameter name and attack class are confirmed from the plugin source; the exact front-end page path is install-specific (the plugin reads $_POST on the events-display page render), so the path is set to the site root and FLAGGED as an inference. name: CVE-2025-10046 - ELEX WooCommerce Google Shopping (Google Product Feed) SQL Injection

description:

displayName: CVE-2025-8985 - SourceCodester COVID 19 Testing Management System SQL Injection
description:
SourceCodester COVID 19 Testing Management System 1.0 is vulnerable to SQL injection via the 'mobilenumber' parameter of /profile.php. The request sends a time-based payload in mobilenumber. METHOD INFERRED: POST (profile is an update form; this app's other injectable forms are POST per the exploit-db report). No vendor WAF rule found; built from the VulDB entry point.

References used to recreate this request:
https://github.com/zhuyi-hz/cve/issues/6 (PoC)
https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/50215 (exploit-db multi-SQLi for this app, shows POST form submissions)
https://vuldb.com/?id.319981 (VulDB entry point: file /profile.php, argument mobilenumber)
https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-8985 (CVE record)

value.input:
POST /profile.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{target_host}}
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Cookie: PHPSESSID=dummy

mobilenumber=1111'+AND+(SELECT+1+FROM+(SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)--+-&submit=Update

name: CVE-2025-8994 - wedevs WP Project Manager WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2025-8994 - wedevs WP Project Manager WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The WP Project Manager plugin for WordPress (<= 2.6.26) is vulnerable to authenticated (Subscriber+) time-based SQL injection via the 'completed_at_operator' parameter, which is concatenated unsanitized into the task-list query in src/Task/Helper/Task.php. The request targets the plugin's REST task-list route GET /wp-json/pm/v2/projects/{id}/tasks (confirmed via the plugin's backend API docs) and sends a SLEEP-based payload in completed_at_operator. Dummy nonce/cookie included for request shape. Built from the Wordfence advisory and the REST route documentation.

References used to recreate this request:
https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/74984cc6-06b1-4c3a-a3e6-9e104c71e9c5?source=cve (Wordfence advisory: time-based SQLi in completed_at_operator, Subscriber+)
https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/browser/wedevs-project-manager/tags/2.6.24/src/Task/Helper/Task.php#L1484 (vulnerable query source)
https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/changeset/3386164/ (fix changeset)
https://deepwiki.com/weDevsOfficial/wp-project-manager/4-backend-api (REST route: GET /pm/v2/projects/{id}/tasks)
https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-8994 (CVE record)

value.input:
GET /wp-json/pm/v2/projects/1/tasks?completed_at=2025-01-01&completed_at_operator=AND%20(SELECT%201%20FROM%20(SELECT(SLEEP(5)))x)%20AND%201=1&per_page=10 HTTP/1.1
Host: {{target_host}}
X-WP-Nonce: dummy
Cookie: wordpress_logged_in=dummy

name: CVE-2026-15022 - Tutor LMS WordPress Plugin SQL Injection

name: CVE-2026-12987 - Events Manager SQL Injection via PHP Object Injection

description:

name: CVE-2026-12050 - pgAdmin 4 SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-12050 - pgAdmin 4 SQL Injection
description:

name: CVE-2026-12044 - pgAdmin 4 SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-12044 - pgAdmin 4 SQL Injection
description:
pgAdmin 4 (before 9.16) is vulnerable to SQL injection across dialog templates that render COMMENT ON ... IS '<description>' for a user-supplied 'description' field (originally reported against the Domain Dialog). The description was interpolated directly inside a single-quoted SQL literal instead of being passed through the qtLiteral escape filter, letting an authenticated pgAdmin user break out of the literal and chain arbitrary SQL. The request submits the Domain create call with a 'description' that closes the COMMENT literal and appends SELECT pg_sleep(5). The reachable endpoint follows pgAdmin's standard NodeView REST route (/browser/domain/obj/{gid}/{sid}/{did}/{scid}/); the exact URL was reconstructed from that documented routing convention because the GitHub PoC/commits were not directly fetchable here. The 'description' sink is from the CVE description and fix commits; no vendor WAF rule found.

name: CVE-2026-4352 - Crocoblock JetEngine SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-4352 - Crocoblock JetEngine SQL Injection
description:
The JetEngine plugin for WordPress (<= 3.8.6.1) is vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection via the Custom Content Type (CCT) REST API search endpoint. The _cct_search GET parameter is interpolated into a SQL query via sprintf() without $wpdb->prepare(), and wp_unslash() strips the magic-quotes protection, enabling single-quote-based injection. The request sends a single-quote UNION SELECT payload in _cct_search against the CCT REST route /wp-json/jet-cct/{slug}/. Source: Wordfence advisory. The CCT slug (here 'team', the Crocoblock docs example) is install-specific - flagged, as any publicly-exposed CCT GET endpoint is affected.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/29a5701f-92f7-4a02-a990-b189a381cff5?source=cve (Wordfence advisory: _cct_search parameter, CCT REST API search endpoint)
- https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/articles/jetengine-how-to-display-custom-content-type-items-using-rest-api/ (CCT REST route /wp-json/jet-cct/{slug}/ with _cct_search query parameter)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-4352 (CVE record)
